name: Data.norm_mul_gProd_pow_mem_modulus
summary: ϖ̄^c divides g^c and N(Q) lies in Q.

steps.claim: g = ϖ̄·conj(ϖ̄) (piGBar_mul_star), so g^c lies in the ideal (ϖ̄)^c = (ϖ̄^c) (span_piGBar, pow_mem_pow); the norm of each place w of Q lies in w (absNorm_mem), so N(Q) = ∏ N(w) lies in ∏ w; hence the product lies in the product ideal ϖ̄^c·Q (mul_mem_mul_rev).
steps.lean:
c).ideal := by with_unfolding_all simpa [← ϑ.Q.prod_coe_sort] using! mul_mem_mul_rev (pow_mem_pow
  (span_piGBar D ▸ mem_span_singleton.2 ⟨_, D.piGBar_mul_star.symm⟩) c) (prod_mem_prod fun _ _ ↦
  absNorm_mem _)
